title: Enhancing Multimodal Large Language Models: From Multimodal Alignment, Fine-Grained Perception to Robust Reasoning

items.abstract: <jats:p>Anomaly detection in moving Electric Multiple Units (EMUs) is critical for railway operational safety. However, current automatic identification methods require extensive manual annotation and often fail to generalize across diverse vehicle types. To address this engineering application challenge, we propose a semi-supervised multi-stage pipeline that offers a scalable, low-resource solution for industrial condition monitoring. The specific artificial intelligence (AI) contribution includes: (1) a high-fidelity unit segmentation approach using a Transformer-based visual model pre-trained on 1.16 million unannotated images and refined via domain-specific constraints; (2) a method to enrich sparse anomaly labels using sensor data and pseudo-label generation via cross-modal feature clustering; and (3) a strategy for injecting domain knowledge into a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) through cross-modal fine-tuning. Experiments demonstrate the method&apos;s effectiveness, achieving 94.8% segmentation accuracy and 99.6% anomaly detection recall on a real-world dataset.</jats:p>
title: A Semi-Supervised Multi-Stage Pipeline for Low-Resource Industrial Condition Monitoring by Injecting Domain Knowledge via Cross-Modal Multimodal Large Language Model Fine-Tuning
